FaqPage.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FaqPage.description: We collected the most common questions from our patients in one place. Contact us if you need more details.

items.question: How can I book an appointment?
items.answer: You can book via the website form, by calling our contact center, or by visiting the clinic in person.

items.question: Can I view lab results online?
items.answer: Yes. Once the personal cabinet functionality is active, results can be downloaded electronically.

items.question: Do you accept insurance?
items.answer: We cooperate with many local insurance providers. Please confirm details with our administrator before your visit.

items.question: Do you provide emergency care?
items.answer: For urgent cases, we have a 24/7 medical team. Our call center will direct you to the right department.

items.question: What documents are required for consultation?
items.answer: Please bring your ID and, if available, previous lab results and treatment history.

PrivacyPolicyPage.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPolicyPage.description: This policy explains how patient information is collected, processed, and protected.

sections.title: 1. Data we collect
sections.content: For appointment registration and medical service delivery, we collect information such as full name, contact details, date of birth, and medical history.

sections.title: 2. Purpose of data usage
sections.content: Collected data is used for treatment workflows, appointment scheduling, lab result handling, and service quality monitoring.

sections.title: 3. Third-party sharing
sections.content: Except where required by law, your information is not shared with third parties without your consent.

sections.title: 4. Security measures
sections.content: Data is stored in protected infrastructure and is accessible only by authorized personnel.

sections.title: 5. Contact
sections.content: For privacy-related questions, please contact privacy@ultramed.az.

TermsPage.title: Terms of Service
TermsPage.description: These terms define usage rules of the Ultramed platform and responsibilities of parties.

sections.title: 1. General provisions
sections.content: By using the website, you agree to these terms. Terms may be updated when necessary.

sections.title: 2. Appointment registration
sections.content: Accuracy of information entered during online registration is the responsibility of the patient.

sections.title: 3. Limitation of liability
sections.content: Information on the website is for awareness purposes and does not replace professional medical advice.

sections.title: 4. Copyright
sections.content: Texts, design, and media elements on the website are protected by copyright of Ultramed and its partners.

sections.title: 5. Governing law
sections.content: Any disputes are resolved in accordance with the legislation of the Republic of Azerbaijan.
